title: 科技就业不足2%：中国AI红利传导弱，政策后手能否托住消费？
speaker: Joe

segments.en: The case with China is that even though they have a very similar external impulse, the impact to capex, as I mentioned, is weaker. The impact on consumer is even less. For example, the share of employment that works in relevant tech manufacturing accounts for less than two percent of total employment in China.
segments.zh: 中国的情况是，尽管外部推力非常相似，但正如我提到的，对资本开支的影响较弱。对消费的影响更小。例如，相关科技制造业就业占总就业不到2%。

segments.en: Just given how massive and diverse the economy is, that feed-through is also more limited on the consumer side. In China, there's a continued drag from the housing downturn. In terms of household wealth effect, you're still seeing decline, and wage expectations are still weak.
segments.zh: 鉴于经济规模庞大且多元，对消费端的传导也更有限。在中国，地产调整持续拖累。就家庭财富效应而言，仍在下降，工资预期也仍偏弱。

segments.en: On top of that, in Taiwan and Korea, one interesting observation is that because of this tech boom, you're seeing higher fiscal revenue, and that is in turn feeding into the broader economy, adding further impulse. In China, you're also seeing higher fiscal revenue from these corporate taxes, but it hasn't translated into higher fiscal spending.
segments.zh: 此外，在台湾和韩国，一个有趣观察是，由于科技繁荣，财政收入更高，这反过来又传导到更广泛经济，增添进一步推力。在中国，企业税收也带来更高财政收入，但尚未转化为更高的财政支出。

segments.en: In part because local government is still constrained by their overall funding condition. With that said, we do think China should maintain a more easing bias. For the PBOC, we don't have any rate cut expectations in the near horizon, but we are seeing they're doing incremental measures to help cushion the downside.
segments.zh: 部分因为地方政府仍受整体资金状况约束。尽管如此，我们认为中国应保持更偏宽松的倾向。对央行，我们短期内没有降息预期，但看到他们正采取增量措施帮助缓冲下行压力。

segments.en: Just a few weeks ago, right before the Golden Week holiday, you did see PBOC come out with more supportive measures, targeted for housing subsidies for example. Going forward, we do think export growth is a really important indicator to watch. Should we see more meaningful slowing on that front, we do think policymakers will come out more proactively and engage with more both fiscal and monetary easing.
segments.zh: 就在几周前，国庆假期前，确实看到央行出台更多支持措施，例如针对住房补贴。展望未来，我们认为出口增长是非常重要的观察指标。如果看到出口明显放缓，我们认为政策制定者会更主动出手，推出更多财政和货币宽松。
